meta.label: MEASURED
meta.platform: rv32sim: pure-Python RV32IMC instruction-set simulator, one instruction per step. A model, not silicon: no pipeline, caches, interrupts or analogue effects.
meta.fault_window: faults land on every executed ROM instruction outside the MAC unit (hmac_hw.c / hmac_sw.c): start-up, header checks, rollback test, compare, jump
meta.goal: the core fetches its first instruction from flash (the image runs) although the image is tampered (tampered_payload) or older than OTP MIN_VERSION (rollback_signed_old)
meta.search: exhaustive for k=1 (all single faults); depth-first with state de-duplication for k>=2, one fault model per search; a budget-stopped level is reported as not completed
